An '''unidentified [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] cargo hauler''' was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Just my luck I got to go back to that scrap pile floating in space.|The cargo hauler|<ref name="Brothers" />}}
This cargo hauler was present on the planet [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] near [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] came up to the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] and demanded that he take him along. The pilot agreed, most likely out of fear, to transport Savage to [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]]. Upon their arrival there, to his dismay, Savage dropped him out of the ship and onto the planet. While he was alive while being dumped from the ship, his condition upon landing was never made clear.<ref name="Brothers" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Sakiyan's model was the recolored model of [[Sixtat/Legends|Sixtat]] from [[The Box]] episode. He was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]].<ref name="Brothers" />
